title: The Dative Person with Inflected Infinitives

sections.content:
The person obligated or allowed is in the dative case (*-nak/-nek*), but dative pronouns (*nekem, neked, neki*) are normally omitted unless you want to emphasize who must do it:
- *Mennem kell.* = I must go.
- ***Nekem** kell mennem, nem neked!* = **I** have to go, not you!
- When a proper name or noun is used, the dative is obligatory: **Péternek** kell mennie (Péter must go), **A diákoknak** sokat kell olvasniuk (The students must read a lot).

items.spanish: Nekem kell megírnom a beszámolót, nem a kollégámnak.
items.english: It is I who has to write the report, not my colleague.

items.spanish: A gyerekeknek időben le kell feküdniük.
items.english: The children have to go to bed on time.

items.spanish: Nem kell sietnünk, van még fél óránk a vonat indulásáig.
items.english: We don't need to hurry, we still have half an hour until the train departs.
